text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision provided it is in keeping with City policy or by-laws. The property at 1700 Avenue Road includes the properties at 1678 to 1704 Avenue Road, 375 to 377 Fairlawn Avenue and 412 to 416 Brookdale Avenue. The owner intends to re-develop the site with a new 7-storey mixed-use building that will contain approximately 80 residential dwelling units and 1,878 square metres of at-grade retail floor space. The building is currently under construction and was approved through the development review process under Zoning By-law Amendment Application No. 11 330290 NNY 16 OZ and Site Plan Application No. 11 330258 NNY 16 SA.
